description: One fresh V7 tabular Q-learning model trained for 15000 rounds against one peaceful_agent, with world seed 21 and agent seed 20021. V7 preserves the 15-bit V6 layout and D4 symmetry, selects exclusive pressure/crate bomb targets at pressure threshold 0.25 with distance discount 0.95, and checks body-blockade survival only at a selected local bomb site. Local alternatives zero all four bomb navigation bits. V3.9 preserves V3.8 shaping and adds +5 per engine-attributed own-bomb opponent kill. Epsilon reaches 0.05 after 10000 rounds. The model is evaluated on five held-out seeds for 200 rounds each.
